summary: Iteration 15 testing complete. All 27 tests passed covering new features: Password Reset Flow (7 tests), Weekly Digest endpoint (2 tests), Admin Pagination (5 tests), and regression tests for auth, ratings, notifications, push tokens, payments, and sessions. Email service confirmed running in NOOP mode (logs email attempts without sending).

Reset tokens properly expire after 1 hour and are marked as 'used' after password reset
Password validation enforces minimum 6 characters on reset
Weekly digest endpoint returns correct summary structure: sessionsThisWeek, totalMinutes, currentStreak, leaderboardRank
Admin pagination working correctly with limit/skip parameters and returns total count
Email service correctly logs all 8 email types in NOOP mode when SENDGRID_API_KEY is not set
Rate limiting working correctly - 10/min for login, 5/min for signup
